import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch, Arc, ConnectionPatch
import numpy as np
import json

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# Set up figure - large for data density
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1, figsize=(28, 20), facecolor='#f5f3f0')
ax.set_facecolor('#f5f3f0')
ax.set_xlim(0, 10)
ax.set_ylim(0, 10)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')

# ── Color palette (technical, data-dense, engineering-focused) ──
C_PRODUCER       = '#1a6b4b'  # dark green
C_PRODUCER_BG    = '#e8f5e9'
C_CONSUMER       = '#1e4d8c'  # dark blue
C_CONSUMER_BG    = '#e3f0ff'
C_PC             = '#7c4700'  # dark amber
C_PC_BG          = '#fff8e1'
C_TOPIC          = '#4a4a5a'  # dark slate
C_TOPIC_BG       = '#eef0f5'
C_DLQ            = '#b71c1c'  # dark red
C_DLQ_BG         = '#fde8e8'
C_SCHEMA         = '#6a1b6a'  # dark purple
C_SCHEMA_BG      = '#f3e5f5'
C_MONITOR        = '#2c3e50'  # dark gray-blue
C_MONITOR_BG     = '#eceff4'
C_ALERT          = '#c62828'  # alert red
C_ALERT_BG       = '#ffebee'

# Flow colors
FLOW_PRODUCE     = '#2e7d32'
FLOW_CONSUME     = '#1565c0'
FLOW_DLQ         = '#c62828'
FLOW_SCHEMA      = '#7b1fa2'
FLOW_MONITOR     = '#546e7a'
FLOW_ALERT       = '#d84315'

def draw_box(ax, x, y, w, h, text, bg_color, border_color, text_color='#1a1a1a',
             fontsize=9, bold=True, subtext=None, subtext2=None):
    """Draw a rounded rectangle with text."""
    box = FancyBboxPatch((x - w/2, y - h/2), w, h,
                         boxstyle="round,pad=0.15", linewidth=1.8,
                         edgecolor=border_color, facecolor=bg_color, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)

    lines = text.count('\n') + 1
    if lines > 1:
        parts = text.split('\n')
        for i, part in enumerate(parts):
            fy = y + (lines-1)*0.06 - i*0.13
            fs = fontsize - 1 if i > 0 else fontsize
            bw = 'bold' if (bold and i == 0) else 'normal'
            ax.text(x, fy, part, ha='center', va='center',
                   fontsize=fs, fontweight=bw, color=text_color,
                   fontfamily='DejaVu Sans', zorder=4)
    else:
        ax.text(x, y, text, ha='center', va='center',
               fontsize=fontsize, fontweight='bold' if bold else 'normal',
               color=text_color, fontfamily='DejaVu Sans', zorder=4)

    if subtext:
        ax.text(x, y - h/2 + 0.06, subtext, ha='center', va='bottom',
               fontsize=6.5, color='#666666', fontfamily='DejaVu Sans',
               fontstyle='italic', zorder=4)

    if subtext2:
        ax.text(x, y - h/2 + 0.18, subtext2, ha='center', va='bottom',
               fontsize=6, color='#888888', fontfamily='DejaVu Sans Mono',
               fontstyle='italic', zorder=4)

def draw_connection(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, lw=0.8, alpha=0.7, ls='-',
                    arrow=True, zorder=1):
    """Draw a line with optional arrow between two points."""
    if arrow:
        ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color, lw=lw,
                                   alpha=alpha, ls=ls,
                                   connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.05',
                                   shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0),
                    zorder=zorder)
    else:
        ax.plot([x1, x2], [y1, y2], color=color, lw=lw, alpha=alpha,
                ls=ls, zorder=zorder)

def draw_curved(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, rad=0.0, lw=0.8, alpha=0.65,
                ls='-', zorder=1):
    """Draw a curved arrow between two points."""
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color, lw=lw,
                               alpha=alpha, ls=ls,
                               connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad}',
                               shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0),
                zorder=zorder)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ZONES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# Zone backgrounds
zones = [
    (0.4, 9.7, 1.2, 7.3, '#eef0f533', 'KAFKA TOPICS (Central Routing Hub)'),
    (0.05, 5.2, 3.4, 4.5, '#e8f5e933', 'PRODUCERS'),
    (6.2, 5.2, 3.6, 4.5, '#e3f0ff33', 'CONSUMERS'),
    (5.8, 3.0, 4.0, 2.0, '#fde8e833', 'DEAD LETTER QUEUES'),
    (0.05, 0.5, 4.8, 2.6, '#eceff433', 'MONITORING & ALERTING'),
    (8.3, 6.8, 1.6, 2.8, '#f3e5f533', 'SCHEMA REGISTRY'),
]

for x, y, w, h, color, label in zones:
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x, y), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.1",
                          linewidth=1, edgecolor='#cccccc',
                          facecolor=color, zorder=0, alpha=0.5)
    ax.add_patch(rect)
    ax.text(x + 0.08, y + h - 0.15, label, fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold',
           color='#777777', fontfamily='DejaVu Sans', zorder=1, alpha=0.8)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TITLE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ax.text(5, 9.85, 'Event-Driven Microservice Architecture — Message Flow Panorama',
        ha='center', va='top', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a2e',
        fontfamily='DejaVu Sans')

def draw_box(ax, x, y, w, h, text, bg_color, border_color, text_color='#1a1a1a',
             fontsize=9, bold=True, subtext=None, subtext2=None):
    """Draw a rounded rectangle with text."""
    box = FancyBboxPatch((x - w/2, y - h/2), w, h,
                         boxstyle="round,pad=0.15", linewidth=1.8,
                         edgecolor=border_color, facecolor=bg_color, zorder=3)
    ax.add_patch(box)

    lines = text.count('\n') + 1
    if lines > 1:
        parts = text.split('\n')
        for i, part in enumerate(parts):
            fy = y + (lines-1)*0.06 - i*0.13
            fs = fontsize - 1 if i > 0 else fontsize
            bw = 'bold' if (bold and i == 0) else 'normal'
            ax.text(x, fy, part, ha='center', va='center',
                   fontsize=fs, fontweight=bw, color=text_color,
                   fontfamily='DejaVu Sans', zorder=4)
    else:
        ax.text(x, y, text, ha='center', va='center',
               fontsize=fontsize, fontweight='bold' if bold else 'normal',
               color=text_color, fontfamily='DejaVu Sans', zorder=4)

    if subtext:
        ax.text(x, y - h/2 + 0.06, subtext, ha='center', va='bottom',
               fontsize=6.5, color='#666666', fontfamily='DejaVu Sans',
               fontstyle='italic', zorder=4)

    if subtext2:
        ax.text(x, y - h/2 + 0.18, subtext2, ha='center', va='bottom',
               fontsize=6, color='#888888', fontfamily='DejaVu Sans Mono',
               fontstyle='italic', zorder=4)

def draw_connection(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, lw=0.8, alpha=0.7, ls='-',
                    arrow=True, zorder=1):
    """Draw a line with optional arrow between two points."""
    if arrow:
        ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color, lw=lw,
                                   alpha=alpha, ls=ls,
                                   connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.05',
                                   shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0),
                    zorder=zorder)
    else:
        ax.plot([x1, x2], [y1, y2], color=color, lw=lw, alpha=alpha,
                ls=ls, zorder=zorder)

def draw_curved(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, rad=0.0, lw=0.8, alpha=0.65,
                ls='-', zorder=1):
    """Draw a curved arrow between two points."""
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color, lw=lw,
                               alpha=alpha, ls=ls,
                               connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad}',
                               shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0),
                zorder=zorder)

def edge_right(node, topic):
    """Edge from service (right side) to topic (left side)."""
    x1 = node[0] + node[2]/2
    y1 = node[1]
    x2 = topic[0] - topic[2]/2
    y2 = topic[1]
    return (x1, y1, x2, y2)

def edge_left(topic, node):
    """Edge from topic (right side) to service (left side)."""
    x1 = topic[0] + topic[2]/2
    y1 = topic[1]
    x2 = node[0] - node[2]/2
    y2 = node[1]
    return (x1, y1, x2, y2)

             fontsize=9, bold=True, subtext=None, subtext2=None):
    """Draw a rounded rectangle with text."""
    box = FancyBboxPatch((x - w/2, y - h/2), w, h,
                         boxstyle="round,pad=0.15", linewidth=1.8,
                         edgecolor=border_color, facecolor=bg_color, zorder=3)

            ax.text(x, fy, part, ha='center', va='center',
                   fontsize=fs, fontweight=bw, color=text_color,
                   fontfamily='DejaVu Sans', zorder=4)

        ax.text(x, y, text, ha='center', va='center',
               fontsize=fontsize, fontweight='bold' if bold else 'normal',
               color=text_color, fontfamily='DejaVu Sans', zorder=4)

    else:

    """Draw a rounded rectangle with text."""
    box = FancyBboxPatch((x - w/2, y - h/2), w, h,
                         boxstyle="round,pad=0.15", linewidth=1.8,
                         edgecolor=border_color, facecolor=bg_color, zorder=3)

                   fontsize=fs, fontweight=bw, color=text_color,
                   fontfamily='DejaVu Sans', zorder=4)

               fontsize=fontsize, fontweight='bold' if bold else 'normal',
               color=text_color, fontfamily='DejaVu Sans', zorder=4)

import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
import os

async def main():
    html_path = '/app/diagram.html'
    output_path = '/app/output/result.png'

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(
            headless=True,
            args=['--no-sandbox', '--disable-setuid-sandbox', '--disable-gpu']
        )
        page = await browser.new_page(viewport={'width': 1920, 'height': 1080})

        # Load the HTML file
        await page.goto(f'file://{html_path}', wait_until='networkidle')

        # Wait for Mermaid to render (the SVG should appear)
        await page.wait_for_selector('svg', timeout=30000)

        # Extra wait for any post-render adjustments
        await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)

        # Get the full content size (Mermaid SVG may be large)
        body = await page.query_selector('body')
        if body:
            box = await body.bounding_box()
            if box:
                await page.set_viewport_size({
                    'width': max(1920, int(box['width']) + 40),
                    'height': max(1080, int(box['height']) + 40)
                })

        # Take full page screenshot
        await page.screenshot(path=output_path, full_page=True)
        print(f'Screenshot saved to {output_path}')

        await browser.close()

asyncio.run(main())

import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

async def main():
    html_path = '/app/diagram.html'
    output_path = '/app/output/result.png'

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(
            headless=True,
            args=['--no-sandbox', '--disable-setuid-sandbox', '--disable-gpu']
        )
        page = await browser.new_page(viewport={'width': 1920, 'height': 1080})

        page.on('console', lambda msg: print(f'[CONSOLE] {msg.type}: {msg.text}'))
        page.on('pageerror', lambda err: print(f'[PAGE ERROR] {err}'))

        await page.goto(f'file://{html_path}', wait_until='networkidle')

        # Wait for SVG to appear (Mermaid renders into the container)
        try:
            await page.wait_for_selector('#diagram-container svg', timeout=60000)
            print('SVG found in container')
        except Exception as e:
            print(f'SVG wait error: {e}')
            content = await page.content()
            # Print first 2000 chars to debug
            print(f'Page content preview: {content[:2000]}')

        # Ensure Mermaid has finished rendering (check for error text)
        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)

        # Check for errors
        error_text = await page.text_content('#diagram-container')
        if error_text and 'Error:' in error_text:
            print(f'Render error: {error_text[:500]}')

        # Get content dimensions
        body = await page.query_selector('body')
        if body:
            box = await body.bounding_box()
            if box:
                w = max(1920, int(box['width']) + 20)
                h = max(1080, int(box['height']) + 20)
                print(f'Setting viewport to {w}x{h}')
                await page.set_viewport_size({'width': w, 'height': h})

        await page.screenshot(path=output_path, full_page=True)
        print(f'Screenshot saved to {output_path}')

        await browser.close()

asyncio.run(main())

import asyncio
import threading
import time
from http.server import HTTPServer, SimpleHTTPRequestHandler
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

async def main():
    # Start a simple HTTP server in a background thread
    server = HTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', 8765), SimpleHTTPRequestHandler)
    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    thread.start()
    print('HTTP server started on port 8765')

    output_path = '/app/output/result.png'

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(
            headless=True,
            args=['--no-sandbox', '--disable-setuid-sandbox', '--disable-gpu']
        )
        page = await browser.new_page(viewport={'width': 1920, 'height': 1080})

        page.on('console', lambda msg: print(f'[CONSOLE] {msg.type}: {msg.text}'))
        page.on('pageerror', lambda err: print(f'[PAGE ERROR] {err}'))

        await page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8765/diagram.html', wait_until='networkidle')

        # Wait for SVG to appear
        try:
            await page.wait_for_selector('#diagram-container svg', timeout=60000)
            print('SVG found in container')
        except Exception as e:
            print(f'SVG wait error: {e}')
            error_text = await page.text_content('#diagram-container')
            print(f'Container content: {error_text[:500] if error_text else "empty"}')

        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)

        # Check for errors
        error_text = await page.text_content('#diagram-container')
        if error_text and 'Error:' in error_text:
            print(f'Render error: {error_text[:500]}')

        # Get content dimensions and take full page screenshot
        body = await page.query_selector('body')
        if body:
            box = await body.bounding_box()
            if box:
                w = max(1920, int(box['width']) + 20)
                h = max(1080, int(box['height']) + 20)
                print(f'Setting viewport to {w}x{h}')
                await page.set_viewport_size({'width': w, 'height': h})

        await page.screenshot(path=output_path, full_page=True)
        print(f'Screenshot saved to {output_path}')

        await browser.close()

    server.shutdown()

asyncio.run(main())

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(30, 22), facecolor='#f8f7f4')
ax.set_facecolor('#f8f7f4')
ax.set_xlim(0, 16)
ax.set_ylim(0, 12)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')

# ── Color palette ──
CP = '#1a6b4b'      # producer
CP_bg = '#e8f5e9'
CC = '#1e4d8c'      # consumer
CC_bg = '#e3f0ff'
PC = '#b45309'      # producer-consumer (amber)
PC_bg = '#fff7ed'
CT = '#374151'      # topic
CT_bg = '#f3f4f6'
CD = '#b91c1c'      # DLQ
CD_bg = '#fef2f2'
CS = '#7b1fa2'      # schema registry
CS_bg = '#faf5ff'
CM = '#334155'      # monitoring
CM_bg = '#f1f5f9'
CA = '#c62828'      # alert
CA_bg = '#fff5f5'

FP = '#2d8a4e'      # flow: produce
FC = '#2563eb'      # flow: consume
FD = '#c62828'      # flow: DLQ
FS = '#9333ea'      # flow: schema
FM = '#64748b'      # flow: monitor

def box(ax, x, y, w, h, label, bg, border, text_color='#1a1a2e',
        fontsize=9, sub1=None, sub2=None):
    """Draw a rounded-rect node."""
    r = FancyBboxPatch((x-w/2, y-h/2), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.12",
                        linewidth=1.8, edgecolor=border, facecolor=bg, zorder=5)
    ax.add_patch(r)
    parts = label.split('\n')
    for i, p in enumerate(parts):
        fy = y + (len(parts)-1)*0.08 - i*0.16
        fs = fontsize - 1 if i > 0 else fontsize
        bw = 'bold' if i == 0 else 'normal'
        ax.text(x, fy, p, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fs,
                fontweight=bw, color=text_color, family='sans-serif', zorder=6)
    if sub1:
        ax.text(x, y - h/2 + 0.06, sub1, ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=6.2, color='#666666', family='monospace', zorder=6,
                fontstyle='italic')
    if sub2:
        ax.text(x, y - h/2 + 0.18, sub2, ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=5.8, color='#999999', family='monospace', zorder=6)

def draw_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, lw=0.8, alpha=0.6, ls='-',
               rad=0.0, zorder=1):
    """Draw a curved arrow."""
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color, lw=lw,
                               alpha=alpha, ls=ls,
                               connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad}',
                               shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0),
                zorder=zorder)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════

# Helper: right side of node to left side of topic

    return (node[0]+node[2]/2, node[1], topic[0]-topic[2]/2, topic[1], rad)

# Helper: right side of topic to left side of node
def t2c(topic, node, rad=0.0):

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np

# ── Figure setup ──
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(30, 22), facecolor='#f8f7f4')
ax.set_facecolor('#f8f7f4')
ax.set_xlim(0, 16)
ax.set_ylim(0, 12)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')

# ── Color palette ──
CP = '#1a6b4b'      # producer
CP_bg = '#e8f5e9'
CC = '#1e4d8c'      # consumer
CC_bg = '#e3f0ff'
PC = '#b45309'      # producer-consumer (amber)
PC_bg = '#fff7ed'
CT = '#374151'      # topic
CT_bg = '#f3f4f6'
CD = '#b91c1c'      # DLQ
CD_bg = '#fef2f2'
CS = '#7b1fa2'      # schema registry
CS_bg = '#faf5ff'
CM = '#334155'      # monitoring
CM_bg = '#f1f5f9'
CA = '#c62828'      # alert
CA_bg = '#fff5f5'

FP = '#2d8a4e'      # flow: produce
FC = '#2563eb'      # flow: consume
FD = '#c62828'      # flow: DLQ
FS = '#9333ea'      # flow: schema
FM = '#64748b'      # flow: monitor

def box(ax, x, y, w, h, label, bg, border, text_color='#1a1a2e',
        fontsize=9, sub1=None, sub2=None):
    """Draw a rounded-rect node."""
    r = FancyBboxPatch((x-w/2, y-h/2), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.12",
                        linewidth=1.8, edgecolor=border, facecolor=bg, zorder=5)
    ax.add_patch(r)
    parts = label.split('\n')
    for i, p in enumerate(parts):
        fy = y + (len(parts)-1)*0.08 - i*0.16
        fs = fontsize - 1 if i > 0 else fontsize
        bw = 'bold' if i == 0 else 'normal'
        ax.text(x, fy, p, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fs,
                fontweight=bw, color=text_color, family='sans-serif', zorder=6)
    if sub1:
        ax.text(x, y - h/2 + 0.06, sub1, ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=6.2, color='#666666', family='monospace', zorder=6,
                fontstyle='italic')
    if sub2:
        ax.text(x, y - h/2 + 0.18, sub2, ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=5.8, color='#999999', family='monospace', zorder=6)

def draw_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, lw=0.8, alpha=0.6, ls='-',
               rad=0.0, zorder=1):
    """Draw a curved arrow."""
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color, lw=lw,
                               alpha=alpha, ls=ls,
                               connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad}',
                               shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0),
                zorder=zorder)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
# ZONE BACKGROUNDS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
zone_defs = [
    (0.3, 5.2, 5.0, 6.3, '#e8f5e9', 'PRODUCERS'),
    (5.5, 5.2, 5.0, 6.3, '#f3f4f6', 'KAFKA TOPICS (Central Hub)'),
    (10.8, 5.2, 5.0, 6.3, '#e3f0ff', 'CONSUMERS'),
    (13.0, 8.5, 2.8, 3.0, '#faf5ff', 'SCHEMA REGISTRY'),
    (10.8, 2.3, 5.0, 2.5, '#fef2f2', 'DEAD LETTER QUEUES'),
    (0.3, 0.4, 10.3, 1.6, '#f1f5f9', 'MONITORING & ALERTING'),
]

for (zx, zy, zw, zh, zc, zlbl) in zone_defs:
    zbox = FancyBboxPatch((zx, zy), zw, zh, boxstyle="round,pad=0.15",
                          linewidth=1, edgecolor='#cccccc',
                          facecolor=zc, zorder=0, alpha=0.5)

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np

# ── Figure setup ──
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(30, 22), facecolor='#f8f7f4')
ax.set_facecolor('#f8f7f4')
ax.set_xlim(0, 16)
ax.set_ylim(0, 12)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')

# ── Color palette ──
CP = '#1a6b4b'      # producer
CP_bg = '#e8f5e9'
CC = '#1e4d8c'      # consumer
CC_bg = '#e3f0ff'

PC_bg = '#fff7ed'
CT = '#374151'      # topic
CT_bg = '#f3f4f6'
CD = '#b91c1c'      # DLQ

CS = '#7b1fa2'      # schema registry
CS_bg = '#faf5ff'
CM = '#334155'      # monitoring
CM_bg = '#f1f5f9'
CA = '#c62828'      # alert
CA_bg = '#fff5f5'

FP = '#2d8a4e'      # flow: produce
FC = '#2563eb'      # flow: consume
FD = '#c62828'      # flow: DLQ
FS = '#9333ea'      # flow: schema
FM = '#64748b'      # flow: monitor

def box(ax, x, y, w, h, label, bg, border, text_color='#1a1a2e',
        fontsize=9, sub1=None, sub2=None):
    """Draw a rounded-rect node."""
    r = FancyBboxPatch((x-w/2, y-h/2), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.12",
                        linewidth=1.8, edgecolor=border, facecolor=bg, zorder=5)
    ax.add_patch(r)
    parts = label.split('\n')
    for i, p in enumerate(parts):
        fy = y + (len(parts)-1)*0.08 - i*0.16
        fs = fontsize - 1 if i > 0 else fontsize
        bw = 'bold' if i == 0 else 'normal'
        ax.text(x, fy, p, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fs,
                fontweight=bw, color=text_color, family='sans-serif', zorder=6)
    if sub1:
        ax.text(x, y - h/2 + 0.06, sub1, ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=6.2, color='#666666', family='monospace', zorder=6,
                fontstyle='italic')
    if sub2:
        ax.text(x, y - h/2 + 0.18, sub2, ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=5.8, color='#999999', family='monospace', zorder=6)

def draw_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, lw=0.8, alpha=0.6, ls='-',
               rad=0.0, zorder=1):
    """Draw a curved arrow."""
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color, lw=lw,
                               alpha=alpha, ls=ls,
                               connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad}',
                               shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0),
                zorder=zorder)

    ax.add_patch(zbox)
    ax.text(zx + 0.12, zy + zh - 0.18, zlbl, fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold',
            color='#999999', family='monospace', zorder=1, alpha=0.75)

ax.text(8, 11.5, 'Producer Services → Kafka Topic Routing Hub → Consumer Services · Schema Registry Validation · DLQ Error Paths · Prometheus Monitoring Pipeline',

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import numpy as np

# ── Figure setup ──
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(30, 22), facecolor='#f8f7f4')
ax.set_facecolor('#f8f7f4')
ax.set_xlim(0, 16)
ax.set_ylim(0, 12)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')

# ── Color palette ──
CP = '#1a6b4b'      # producer
CP_bg = '#e8f5e9'
CC = '#1e4d8c'      # consumer
CC_bg = '#e3f0ff'
PC = '#b45309'      # producer-consumer (amber)
PC_bg = '#fff7ed'
CT = '#374151'      # topic
CT_bg = '#f3f4f6'
CD = '#b91c1c'      # DLQ
CD_bg = '#fef2f2'
CS = '#7b1fa2'      # schema registry
CS_bg = '#faf5ff'
CM = '#334155'      # monitoring
CM_bg = '#f1f5f9'
CA = '#c62828'      # alert
CA_bg = '#fff5f5'

FP = '#2d8a4e'      # flow: produce
FC = '#2563eb'      # flow: consume
FD = '#c62828'      # flow: DLQ
FS = '#9333ea'      # flow: schema
FM = '#64748b'      # flow: monitor

def box(ax, x, y, w, h, label, bg, border, text_color='#1a1a2e',
        fontsize=9, sub1=None, sub2=None):
    """Draw a rounded-rect node."""
    r = FancyBboxPatch((x-w/2, y-h/2), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.12",
                        linewidth=1.8, edgecolor=border, facecolor=bg, zorder=5)
    ax.add_patch(r)
    parts = label.split('\n')
    for i, p in enumerate(parts):
        fy = y + (len(parts)-1)*0.08 - i*0.16
        fs = fontsize - 1 if i > 0 else fontsize
        bw = 'bold' if i == 0 else 'normal'
        ax.text(x, fy, p, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fs,
                fontweight=bw, color=text_color, family='sans-serif', zorder=6)
    if sub1:
        ax.text(x, y - h/2 + 0.06, sub1, ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=6.2, color='#666666', family='monospace', zorder=6,
                fontstyle='italic')
    if sub2:
        ax.text(x, y - h/2 + 0.18, sub2, ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=5.8, color='#999999', family='monospace', zorder=6)

def draw_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, lw=0.8, alpha=0.6, ls='-',
               rad=0.0, zorder=1):
    """Draw a curved arrow."""
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color, lw=lw,
                               alpha=alpha, ls=ls,
                               connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad}',
                               shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0),
                zorder=zorder)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
# ZONE BACKGROUNDS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
zone_defs = [
    (0.3, 5.2, 5.0, 6.3, '#e8f5e9', 'PRODUCERS'),
    (5.5, 5.2, 5.0, 6.3, '#f3f4f6', 'KAFKA TOPICS (Central Hub)'),
    (10.8, 5.2, 5.0, 6.3, '#e3f0ff', 'CONSUMERS'),
    (13.0, 8.5, 2.8, 3.0, '#faf5ff', 'SCHEMA REGISTRY'),
    (10.8, 2.3, 5.0, 2.5, '#fef2f2', 'DEAD LETTER QUEUES'),
    (0.3, 0.4, 10.3, 1.6, '#f1f5f9', 'MONITORING & ALERTING'),
]

for (zx, zy, zw, zh, zc, zlbl) in zone_defs:
    zbox = FancyBboxPatch((zx, zy), zw, zh, boxstyle="round,pad=0.15",
                          linewidth=1, edgecolor='#cccccc',
                          facecolor=zc, zorder=0, alpha=0.5)
    ax.add_patch(zbox)
    ax.text(zx + 0.12, zy + zh - 0.18, zlbl, fontsize=7.5, fontweight='bold',
            color='#999999', family='monospace', zorder=1, alpha=0.75)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
# TITLE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
ax.text(8, 11.8, 'Event-Driven Microservice Architecture — Message Flow Panorama',
        ha='center', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a2e')
ax.text(8, 11.5, 'Producer Services → Kafka Topic Routing Hub → Consumer Services · Schema Registry Validation · DLQ Error Paths · Prometheus Monitoring Pipeline',
        ha='center', fontsize=9, color='#6b7280', fontstyle='italic')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
# NODE POSITIONS (x, y, w, h)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════

# -- Producers (left column, x ~ 2.8) --
SVCO = (2.8, 10.4, 2.5, 0.9)      # Order Service

# -- Producer-Consumers --
SVCP = (2.8, 8.6, 2.8, 1.1)       # Payment Service
SVCI = (2.8, 7.0, 2.8, 1.1)       # Inventory Service

# -- Kafka Topics (center, x=8.0, column layout) --
T_OC = (8.0, 10.65, 2.0, 0.5)     # orders.created
T_OU = (8.0, 9.95, 2.0, 0.5)      # orders.updated
T_PC = (8.0, 9.05, 2.0, 0.5)      # payments.completed
T_PF = (8.0, 8.35, 2.0, 0.5)      # payments.failed
T_IR = (8.0, 7.45, 2.0, 0.5)      # inventory.reserved
T_IE = (8.0, 6.75, 2.0, 0.5)      # inventory.released
T_SD = (8.0, 6.05, 2.0, 0.5)      # shipping.dispatched

# -- Consumers (right column, x ~ 13.2) --
SVCS = (13.2, 9.5, 2.5, 0.9)      # Shipping Service
SVCN = (13.2, 8.0, 2.5, 0.9)      # Notification Service
SVCA = (13.2, 6.5, 2.5, 0.9)      # Analytics Service

# -- DLQ Topics --
DLQP = (12.0, 3.8, 2.0, 0.5)      # dlq.payments
DLQI = (12.0, 3.1, 2.0, 0.5)      # dlq.inventory
DLQS = (14.5, 3.8, 2.0, 0.5)      # dlq.shipping
DLQN = (14.5, 3.1, 2.0, 0.5)      # dlq.notification

# -- Schema Registry --
SCHR = (14.3, 10.0, 1.8, 1.3)     # Schema Registry

# -- Monitoring --
PROM = (2.0, 1.1, 1.8, 0.7)       # Prometheus
GRAF = (4.5, 1.1, 1.5, 0.6)       # Grafana
ALTM = (7.0, 1.1, 1.8, 0.6)       # Alertmanager
PDTY = (9.5, 1.1, 1.5, 0.6)       # PagerDuty
SLCK = (11.5, 1.1, 1.4, 0.6)      # Slack

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
# DRAW ALL NODES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════

# Producers
box(ax, *SVCO, 'Order Service', CP_bg, CP, CP, 10,
    'Producer', 'No Retry')
box(ax, *SVCP, 'Payment Service', PC_bg, PC, PC, 10,
    'Producer-Consumer', 'Exp-Backoff · 5 retries · jitter=yes')
box(ax, *SVCI, 'Inventory Service', PC_bg, PC, PC, 10,
    'Producer-Consumer', 'Fixed-Interval · 3 retries · jitter=no')

# Topics
topic_nodes = [
    (T_OC, 'orders.created', '12p · rf3 · 168h · 5k msg/s'),
    (T_OU, 'orders.updated', '6p · rf3 · 168h · 3k msg/s'),
    (T_PC, 'payments.completed', '12p · rf3 · 336h · 4k msg/s'),
    (T_PF, 'payments.failed', '6p · rf3 · 336h · 0.8k msg/s'),
    (T_IR, 'inventory.reserved', '8p · rf3 · 72h · 4.5k msg/s'),
    (T_IE, 'inventory.released', '4p · rf3 · 72h · 0.6k msg/s'),
    (T_SD, 'shipping.dispatched', '8p · rf3 · 168h · 2k msg/s'),
]
for (tx, ty, tw, th), name, info in topic_nodes:
    box(ax, tx, ty, tw, th, name, CT_bg, CT, CT, 8.5, info)

# DLQ Topics
box(ax, *DLQP, 'dlq.payments', CD_bg, CD, '#991b1b', 7.5, '3p · rf3 · 720h')
box(ax, *DLQI, 'dlq.inventory', CD_bg, CD, '#991b1b', 7.5, '3p · rf3 · 720h')
box(ax, *DLQS, 'dlq.shipping', CD_bg, CD, '#991b1b', 7.5, '3p · rf3 · 720h')
box(ax, *DLQN, 'dlq.notification', CD_bg, CD, '#991b1b', 7.5, '2p · rf3 · 720h')

# Consumers
box(ax, *SVCS, 'Shipping Service', CC_bg, CC, CC, 10,
    'Consumer', 'Exp-Backoff · 4 retries · jitter=yes')
box(ax, *SVCN, 'Notification Service', CC_bg, CC, CC, 10,
    'Consumer', 'Fixed-Interval · 2 retries · jitter=no')
box(ax, *SVCA, 'Analytics Service', CC_bg, CC, CC, 10,
    'Consumer', 'No Retry (best-effort)')

# Schema Registry
box(ax, *SCHR, 'Schema Registry\nAVRO Validation\nGatekeeper',
    CS_bg, CS, CS, 8.5, 'sync-http · bidirectional')

# Monitoring
box(ax, *PROM, 'Prometheus', CM_bg, CM, '#1e293b', 9, '10-30s scrape')
box(ax, *GRAF, 'Grafana', CM_bg, CM, '#1e293b', 8.5, 'EDA Dashboard')
box(ax, *ALTM, 'Alertmanager', CA_bg, CA, '#7f1d1d', 8.5, 'Alert Rules')
box(ax, *PDTY, 'PagerDuty', CA_bg, CA, '#7f1d1d', 8.5, 'Critical')
box(ax, *SLCK, 'Slack', CM_bg, CM, '#1e293b', 8.5, 'Warnings')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════
# EDGES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════

# Helper: right side of node to left side of topic
def p2t(node, topic, rad=0.0):
    return (node[0]+node[2]/2, node[1], topic[0]-topic[2]/2, topic[1], rad)

# Helper: right side of topic to left side of node
def t2c(topic, node, rad=0.0):
    return (topic[0]+topic[2]/2, topic[1], node[0]-node[2]/2, node[1], rad)

# ── PRODUCE (green) ──
produce_flows = [
    (SVCO, T_OC), (SVCO, T_OU),
    (SVCP, T_PC), (SVCP, T_PF),
    (SVCI, T_IR), (SVCI, T_IE),
    (SVCS, T_SD),
]
p_rads = [0.0, -0.06, 0.04, -0.04, 0.04, -0.04, 0.0]
for i, (src, tgt) in enumerate(produce_flows):
    x1, y1, x2, y2, _ = p2t(src, tgt, p_rads[i])
    draw_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, FP, lw=1.2, alpha=0.55, rad=p_rads[i])

# ── CONSUME (blue) ──
consume_flows = [
    (T_OC, SVCP, 0.03), (T_OC, SVCI, -0.03),
    (T_OC, SVCN, 0.0), (T_OC, SVCA, 0.1),
    (T_OU, SVCA, -0.06),
    (T_PC, SVCS, 0.04), (T_PC, SVCN, 0.0), (T_PC, SVCA, 0.1),
    (T_PF, SVCI, -0.06), (T_PF, SVCN, -0.03), (T_PF, SVCA, -0.08),
    (T_IR, SVCS, 0.04), (T_IR, SVCA, 0.1),
    (T_IE, SVCA, -0.06),
    (T_SD, SVCN, -0.03), (T_SD, SVCA, 0.04),
]
for src, tgt, rad in consume_flows:
    x1, y1, x2, y2, _ = t2c(src, tgt, rad)
    draw_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, FC, lw=0.9, alpha=0.5, rad=rad)

# ── DLQ (red, dashed) ──
dlq_map = [
    (SVCP, DLQP, 0.2), (SVCI, DLQI, 0.15),
    (SVCS, DLQS, 0.15), (SVCN, DLQN, 0.15),
]
for src, tgt, rad in dlq_map:
    x1, y1 = src[0]+src[2]/2, src[1]
    x2, y2 = tgt[0]-tgt[2]/2, tgt[1]
    draw_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, FD, lw=1.6, alpha=0.7, ls='--', rad=rad, zorder=4)

# ── SCHEMA REGISTRY (purple, dotted, bidirectional) ──
schema_services = [SVCO, SVCP, SVCI, SVCS, SVCN, SVCA]
schema_rads = [-0.1, -0.06, -0.02, 0.02, 0.06, 0.1]
for svc, rad in zip(schema_services, schema_rads):
    x1, y1 = svc[0]+svc[2]/2, svc[1]
    x2, y2 = SCHR[0]-SCHR[2]/2, SCHR[1]
    # forward arrow
    draw_arrow(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, FS, lw=0.7, alpha=0.45, ls=':', rad=rad)
    # reverse arrow
    draw_arrow(ax, x2, y2, x1, y1, FS, lw=0.7, alpha=0.45, ls=':', rad=-rad-0.01)

# ── MONITORING (gray) ──
# Services/Prometheus → monitoring
mon_sources = [SVCO, SVCP, SVCI, SVCS, SVCN, SVCA]
for svc in mon_sources:

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
import numpy as np

# ── Figure setup - compact, data-dense ──
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(24, 18), facecolor='#f5f3f0')
ax.set_facecolor('#f5f3f0')
ax.set_xlim(0, 24)
ax.set_ylim(0, 18)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')

# ── Color palette ──
CP = '#1a6b4b'
CP_bg = '#d4edda'
PC = '#b45309'
PC_bg = '#fff3cd'
CC = '#1e4d8c'
CC_bg = '#cfe2ff'
CT = '#374151'
CT_bg = '#e5e7eb'
CD = '#b91c1c'
CD_bg = '#f8d7da'
CS = '#6b21a8'
CS_bg = '#e9d5ff'
CM = '#334155'
CM_bg = '#e2e8f0'
CA = '#c62828'
CA_bg = '#ffcdd2'
FP = '#16a34a'
FC = '#2563eb'
FD = '#dc2626'
FS = '#9333ea'
FM = '#64748b'
FA = '#ea580c'

# ── Helpers ──
def draw_box(ax, x, y, w, h, label, bg, border, fc='#1a1a1a',
             fs=9, sub1=None, sub2=None):
    r = FancyBboxPatch((x-w/2, y-h/2), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=8",
                        linewidth=2.0, edgecolor=border, facecolor=bg, zorder=5)
    ax.add_patch(r)
    parts = label.split('\n')
    for i, p in enumerate(parts):
        fy = y + (len(parts)-1)*0.12 - i*0.22
        fw = 'bold' if i == 0 else 'normal'
        ax.text(x, fy, p, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fs-(1 if i>0 else 0),
                fontweight=fw, color=fc, family='sans-serif', zorder=6)
    if sub1:
        ax.text(x, y-h/2+0.06, sub1, ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=6.5, color='#555', family='monospace', fontstyle='italic', zorder=6)
    if sub2:
        ax.text(x, y-h/2+0.18, sub2, ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=6, color='#888', family='monospace', zorder=6)

def conn(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, lw=1.0, alpha=0.65, ls='-', rad=0.0, zorder=2):
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color, lw=lw,
                               alpha=alpha, ls=ls,
                               connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad}',
                               shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0),
                zorder=zorder)

# ── Zone labels ──
zone_data = [
    (1.6, 5.0, 5.5, 12.0, '#d4edda', 'PRODUCERS'),
    (7.3, 5.0, 5.4, 12.0, '#e5e7eb', 'KAFKA TOPICS'),
    (12.9, 5.0, 5.5, 12.0, '#cfe2ff', 'CONSUMERS'),
    (18.6, 5.0, 4.0, 12.0, '#e9d5ff', 'SCHEMA REGISTRY'),
    (7.3, 1.2, 11.2, 3.2, '#f8d7da', 'DEAD LETTER QUEUES'),
]
for zx, zy, zw, zh, zc, zl in zone_data:
    zr = FancyBboxPatch((zx, zy), zw, zh, boxstyle="round,pad=12",
                         linewidth=1.5, edgecolor='#bbb', facecolor=zc, zorder=0, alpha=0.45)
    ax.add_patch(zr)
    ax.text(zx+0.15, zy+zh-0.25, zl, fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold',
            color='#888', family='monospace', alpha=0.7)

# ── Title ──
ax.text(12, 17.7, 'Event-Driven Microservice Architecture — Message Flow Panorama',
        ha='center', fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a2e')
ax.text(12, 17.3, 'Producer → Kafka Topic Hub → Consumer · Schema Registry Validation · DLQ Error Paths · Monitoring Pipeline',
        ha='center', fontsize=9.5, color='#6b7280', fontstyle='italic')

# ── NODE LAYOUT ──
# (x, y, w, h) for each node
SVCO = (3.0, 15.5, 3.4, 1.3)     # Order Svc
SVCP = (3.0, 13.0, 3.6, 1.5)     # Payment Svc
SVCI = (3.0, 10.5, 3.6, 1.5)     # Inventory Svc

T_OC = (10.0, 16.2, 2.8, 0.75)   # orders.created
T_OU = (10.0, 15.1, 2.8, 0.75)   # orders.updated
T_PC = (10.0, 13.7, 2.8, 0.75)   # payments.completed
T_PF = (10.0, 12.6, 2.8, 0.75)   # payments.failed
T_IR = (10.0, 11.2, 2.8, 0.75)   # inventory.reserved
T_IE = (10.0, 10.1, 2.8, 0.75)   # inventory.released
T_SD = (10.0, 9.0, 2.8, 0.75)    # shipping.dispatched

SVCS = (16.5, 14.5, 3.2, 1.3)    # Shipping Svc
SVCN = (16.5, 12.0, 3.2, 1.3)    # Notification Svc
SVCA = (16.5, 9.5, 3.2, 1.3)     # Analytics Svc

SCHR = (20.6, 14.5, 2.8, 2.5)    # Schema Registry

DLQP = (12.5, 3.5, 2.2, 0.7)     # dlq.payments
DLQI = (15.0, 3.5, 2.2, 0.7)     # dlq.inventory
DLQS = (12.5, 2.3, 2.2, 0.7)     # dlq.shipping
DLQN = (15.0, 2.3, 2.2, 0.7)     # dlq.notification

# ── Draw all nodes ──
# Producers
draw_box(ax, *SVCO, 'Order Service', CP_bg, CP, CP, 11, 'Producer · No Retry')
draw_box(ax, *SVCP, 'Payment Service', PC_bg, PC, PC, 11, 'Producer-Consumer', 'Exp-Backoff · 5 retries · jitter')
draw_box(ax, *SVCI, 'Inventory Service', PC_bg, PC, PC, 11, 'Producer-Consumer', 'Fixed-Interval · 3 retries · no jitter')

# Topics
topic_nodes = [
    (T_OC, 'orders.created', '12 partitions · rf3 · 168h · 5k msg/s'),
    (T_OU, 'orders.updated', '6 partitions · rf3 · 168h · 3k msg/s'),
    (T_PC, 'payments.completed', '12 partitions · rf3 · 336h · 4k msg/s'),
    (T_PF, 'payments.failed', '6 partitions · rf3 · 336h · 0.8k msg/s'),
    (T_IR, 'inventory.reserved', '8 partitions · rf3 · 72h · 4.5k msg/s'),
    (T_IE, 'inventory.released', '4 partitions · rf3 · 72h · 0.6k msg/s'),
    (T_SD, 'shipping.dispatched', '8 partitions · rf3 · 168h · 2k msg/s'),
]
for (tx, ty, tw, th), name, info in topic_nodes:
    draw_box(ax, tx, ty, tw, th, name, CT_bg, CT, '#1f2937', 9.5, info)

# Consumers
draw_box(ax, *SVCS, 'Shipping Service', CC_bg, CC, CC, 11, 'Consumer', 'Exp-Backoff · 4 retries · jitter')
draw_box(ax, *SVCN, 'Notification Service', CC_bg, CC, CC, 11, 'Consumer', 'Fixed-Interval · 2 retries · no jitter')
draw_box(ax, *SVCA, 'Analytics Service', CC_bg, CC, CC, 11, 'Consumer · Best-Effort · No Retry')

# Schema Registry
draw_box(ax, *SCHR, 'Schema Registry\n(AVRO Validation\nGatekeeper)', CS_bg, CS, CS, 10, 'sync-http · bidirectional')

# DLQ Topics
dlq_nodes = [
    (DLQP, 'dlq.payments', '3p · rf3 · 720h'),
    (DLQI, 'dlq.inventory', '3p · rf3 · 720h'),
    (DLQS, 'dlq.shipping', '3p · rf3 · 720h'),
    (DLQN, 'dlq.notification', '2p · rf3 · 720h'),
]
for (dx, dy, dw, dh), name, info in dlq_nodes:
    draw_box(ax, dx, dy, dw, dh, name, CD_bg, CD, '#991b1b', 8.5, info)

# ── EDGES ──
# Produce (green)
produce_edges = [
    (SVCO, T_OC, 0.0), (SVCO, T_OU, -0.06),
    (SVCP, T_PC, 0.04), (SVCP, T_PF, -0.04),
    (SVCI, T_IR, 0.04), (SVCI, T_IE, -0.04),
    (SVCS, T_SD, 0.0),
]
for src, tgt, rad in produce_edges:
    x1, y1 = src[0]+src[2]/2, src[1]
    x2, y2 = tgt[0]-tgt[2]/2, tgt[1]
    conn(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, FP, lw=1.3, alpha=0.65, rad=rad)

# Consume (blue)
consume_edges = [
    (T_OC, SVCP, 0.04), (T_OC, SVCI, -0.04), (T_OC, SVCN, 0.0), (T_OC, SVCA, 0.1),
    (T_OU, SVCA, -0.08),
    (T_PC, SVCS, 0.05), (T_PC, SVCN, 0.0), (T_PC, SVCA, 0.1),
    (T_PF, SVCI, -0.06), (T_PF, SVCN, -0.04), (T_PF, SVCA, -0.1),
    (T_IR, SVCS, 0.05), (T_IR, SVCA, 0.1),
    (T_IE, SVCA, -0.08),
    (T_SD, SVCN, -0.04), (T_SD, SVCA, 0.06),
]
for src, tgt, rad in consume_edges:
    x1, y1 = src[0]+src[2]/2, src[1]
    x2, y2 = tgt[0]-tgt[2]/2, tgt[1]
    conn(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, FC, lw=1.0, alpha=0.55, rad=rad)

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
import numpy as np

# ── Figure setup - compact, data-dense ──
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(24, 18), facecolor='#f5f3f0')
ax.set_facecolor('#f5f3f0')
ax.set_xlim(0, 24)
ax.set_ylim(0, 18)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')

# ── Color palette ──
CP = '#1a6b4b'
CP_bg = '#d4edda'
PC = '#b45309'
PC_bg = '#fff3cd'
CC = '#1e4d8c'
CC_bg = '#cfe2ff'
CT = '#374151'
CT_bg = '#e5e7eb'
CD = '#b91c1c'
CD_bg = '#f8d7da'
CS = '#6b21a8'
CS_bg = '#e9d5ff'
CM = '#334155'
CM_bg = '#e2e8f0'
CA = '#c62828'
CA_bg = '#ffcdd2'
FP = '#16a34a'
FC = '#2563eb'
FD = '#dc2626'
FS = '#9333ea'
FM = '#64748b'
FA = '#ea580c'

# ── Helpers ──
def draw_box(ax, x, y, w, h, label, bg, border, fc='#1a1a1a',
             fs=9, sub1=None, sub2=None):
    r = FancyBboxPatch((x-w/2, y-h/2), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=8",
                        linewidth=2.0, edgecolor=border, facecolor=bg, zorder=5)
    ax.add_patch(r)
    parts = label.split('\n')
    for i, p in enumerate(parts):
        fy = y + (len(parts)-1)*0.12 - i*0.22
        fw = 'bold' if i == 0 else 'normal'
        ax.text(x, fy, p, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fs-(1 if i>0 else 0),
                fontweight=fw, color=fc, family='sans-serif', zorder=6)
    if sub1:
        ax.text(x, y-h/2+0.06, sub1, ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=6.5, color='#555', family='monospace', fontstyle='italic', zorder=6)
    if sub2:
        ax.text(x, y-h/2+0.18, sub2, ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=6, color='#888', family='monospace', zorder=6)

def conn(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, lw=1.0, alpha=0.65, ls='-', rad=0.0, zorder=2):
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color, lw=lw,
                               alpha=alpha, ls=ls,
                               connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad}',
                               shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0),
                zorder=zorder)

# ── Zone labels ──
zone_data = [
    (1.6, 5.0, 5.5, 12.0, '#d4edda', 'PRODUCERS'),
    (7.3, 5.0, 5.4, 12.0, '#e5e7eb', 'KAFKA TOPICS'),
    (12.9, 5.0, 5.5, 12.0, '#cfe2ff', 'CONSUMERS'),
    (18.6, 5.0, 4.0, 12.0, '#e9d5ff', 'SCHEMA REGISTRY'),
    (7.3, 1.2, 11.2, 3.2, '#f8d7da', 'DEAD LETTER QUEUES'),
]
for zx, zy, zw, zh, zc, zl in zone_data:
    zr = FancyBboxPatch((zx, zy), zw, zh, boxstyle="round,pad=12",
                         linewidth=1.5, edgecolor='#bbb', facecolor=zc, zorder=0, alpha=0.45)
    ax.add_patch(zr)
    ax.text(zx+0.15, zy+zh-0.25, zl, fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold',
            color='#888', family='monospace', alpha=0.7)

# ── Title ──
ax.text(12, 17.7, 'Event-Driven Microservice Architecture — Message Flow Panorama',
        ha='center', fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', color='#1a1a2e')
ax.text(12, 17.3, 'Producer → Kafka Topic Hub → Consumer · Schema Registry Validation · DLQ Error Paths · Monitoring Pipeline',
        ha='center', fontsize=9.5, color='#6b7280', fontstyle='italic')

# ── NODE LAYOUT ──
# (x, y, w, h) for each node
SVCO = (3.0, 15.5, 3.4, 1.3)     # Order Svc
SVCP = (3.0, 13.0, 3.6, 1.5)     # Payment Svc
SVCI = (3.0, 10.5, 3.6, 1.5)     # Inventory Svc

T_OC = (10.0, 16.2, 2.8, 0.75)   # orders.created
T_OU = (10.0, 15.1, 2.8, 0.75)   # orders.updated
T_PC = (10.0, 13.7, 2.8, 0.75)   # payments.completed
T_PF = (10.0, 12.6, 2.8, 0.75)   # payments.failed
T_IR = (10.0, 11.2, 2.8, 0.75)   # inventory.reserved
T_IE = (10.0, 10.1, 2.8, 0.75)   # inventory.released
T_SD = (10.0, 9.0, 2.8, 0.75)    # shipping.dispatched

SVCS = (16.5, 14.5, 3.2, 1.3)    # Shipping Svc
SVCN = (16.5, 12.0, 3.2, 1.3)    # Notification Svc
SVCA = (16.5, 9.5, 3.2, 1.3)     # Analytics Svc

SCHR = (20.6, 14.5, 2.8, 2.5)    # Schema Registry

DLQP = (12.5, 3.5, 2.2, 0.7)     # dlq.payments
DLQI = (15.0, 3.5, 2.2, 0.7)     # dlq.inventory
DLQS = (12.5, 2.3, 2.2, 0.7)     # dlq.shipping
DLQN = (15.0, 2.3, 2.2, 0.7)     # dlq.notification

# ── Draw all nodes ──
# Producers
draw_box(ax, *SVCO, 'Order Service', CP_bg, CP, CP, 11, 'Producer · No Retry')
draw_box(ax, *SVCP, 'Payment Service', PC_bg, PC, PC, 11, 'Producer-Consumer', 'Exp-Backoff · 5 retries · jitter')
draw_box(ax, *SVCI, 'Inventory Service', PC_bg, PC, PC, 11, 'Producer-Consumer', 'Fixed-Interval · 3 retries · no jitter')

# Topics
topic_nodes = [
    (T_OC, 'orders.created', '12 partitions · rf3 · 168h · 5k msg/s'),
    (T_OU, 'orders.updated', '6 partitions · rf3 · 168h · 3k msg/s'),
    (T_PC, 'payments.completed', '12 partitions · rf3 · 336h · 4k msg/s'),

draw_box(ax, *SVCA, 'Analytics Service', CC_bg, CC, CC, 11, 'Consumer · Best-Effort · No Retry')

draw_box(ax, *SCHR, 'Schema Registry\n(AVRO Validation\nGatekeeper)', CS_bg, CS, CS, 10, 'sync-http · bidirectional')

dlq_nodes = [
    (DLQP, 'dlq.payments', '3p · rf3 · 720h'),
    (DLQI, 'dlq.inventory', '3p · rf3 · 720h'),
    (DLQS, 'dlq.shipping', '3p · rf3 · 720h'),
    (DLQN, 'dlq.notification', '2p · rf3 · 720h'),
]
for (dx, dy, dw, dh), name, info in dlq_nodes:
    draw_box(ax, dx, dy, dw, dh, name, CD_bg, CD, '#991b1b', 8.5, info)

# ── EDGES ──
# Produce (green)
produce_edges = [
    (SVCO, T_OC, 0.0), (SVCO, T_OU, -0.06),
    (SVCP, T_PC, 0.04), (SVCP, T_PF, -0.04),
    (SVCI, T_IR, 0.04), (SVCI, T_IE, -0.04),
    (SVCS, T_SD, 0.0),

for src, tgt, rad in produce_edges:

    conn(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, FP, lw=1.3, alpha=0.65, rad=rad)

schema_svcs = [SVCO, SVCP, SVCI, SVCS, SVCN, SVCA]

SLCK = (15.5, 1.2, 2.0, 0.9)

draw_box(ax, *PROM, 'Prometheus', CM_bg, CM, '#1e293b', 10, 'Metrics Collection · 10-30s scrape')
draw_box(ax, *GRAF, 'Grafana', CM_bg, CM, '#1e293b', 9.5, 'EDA Dashboard')

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
import numpy as np

# ── Figure setup - compact, data-dense ──
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(24, 18), facecolor='#f5f3f0')
ax.set_facecolor('#f5f3f0')
ax.set_xlim(0, 24)
ax.set_ylim(0, 18)
ax.set_aspect('equal')
ax.axis('off')

# ── Color palette ──
CP = '#1a6b4b'
CP_bg = '#d4edda'
PC = '#b45309'
PC_bg = '#fff3cd'
CC = '#1e4d8c'
CC_bg = '#cfe2ff'
CT = '#374151'
CT_bg = '#e5e7eb'
CD = '#b91c1c'
CD_bg = '#f8d7da'
CS = '#6b21a8'
CS_bg = '#e9d5ff'
CM = '#334155'
CM_bg = '#e2e8f0'
CA = '#c62828'
CA_bg = '#ffcdd2'
FP = '#16a34a'
FC = '#2563eb'
FD = '#dc2626'
FS = '#9333ea'
FM = '#64748b'
FA = '#ea580c'

# ── Helpers ──
def draw_box(ax, x, y, w, h, label, bg, border, fc='#1a1a1a',
             fs=9, sub1=None, sub2=None):
    r = FancyBboxPatch((x-w/2, y-h/2), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=8",
                        linewidth=2.0, edgecolor=border, facecolor=bg, zorder=5)
    ax.add_patch(r)
    parts = label.split('\n')
    for i, p in enumerate(parts):
        fy = y + (len(parts)-1)*0.12 - i*0.22
        fw = 'bold' if i == 0 else 'normal'
        ax.text(x, fy, p, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fs-(1 if i>0 else 0),
                fontweight=fw, color=fc, family='sans-serif', zorder=6)
    if sub1:
        ax.text(x, y-h/2+0.06, sub1, ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=6.5, color='#555', family='monospace', fontstyle='italic', zorder=6)
    if sub2:
        ax.text(x, y-h/2+0.18, sub2, ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=6, color='#888', family='monospace', zorder=6)

def conn(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, lw=1.0, alpha=0.65, ls='-', rad=0.0, zorder=2):
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color, lw=lw,
                               alpha=alpha, ls=ls,
                               connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad}',
                               shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0),
                zorder=zorder)

# ── Zone labels ──
zone_data = [
    (1.6, 5.0, 5.5, 12.0, '#d4edda', 'PRODUCERS'),
    (7.3, 5.0, 5.4, 12.0, '#e5e7eb', 'KAFKA TOPICS'),
    (12.9, 5.0, 5.5, 12.0, '#cfe2ff', 'CONSUMERS'),
    (18.6, 5.0, 4.0, 12.0, '#e9d5ff', 'SCHEMA REGISTRY'),
    (7.3, 1.2, 11.2, 3.2, '#f8d7da', 'DEAD LETTER QUEUES'),
]

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch

def draw_box(ax, x, y, w, h, label, bg, border, fc='#1a1a1a',
             fs=9, sub1=None, sub2=None):
    r = FancyBboxPatch((x-w/2, y-h/2), w, h, boxstyle="round,pad=8",
                        linewidth=2.0, edgecolor=border, facecolor=bg, zorder=5)
    ax.add_patch(r)
    parts = label.split('\n')
    for i, p in enumerate(parts):
        fy = y + (len(parts)-1)*0.12 - i*0.22
        fw = 'bold' if i == 0 else 'normal'
        ax.text(x, fy, p, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=fs-(1 if i>0 else 0),
                fontweight=fw, color=fc, family='sans-serif', zorder=6)
    if sub1:
        ax.text(x, y-h/2+0.06, sub1, ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=6.5, color='#555', family='monospace', fontstyle='italic', zorder=6)
    if sub2:
        ax.text(x, y-h/2+0.18, sub2, ha='center', va='bottom',
                fontsize=6, color='#888', family='monospace', zorder=6)

def conn(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, lw=1.0, alpha=0.65, ls='-', rad=0.0, zorder=2):
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=color, lw=lw,
                               alpha=alpha, ls=ls,
                               connectionstyle=f'arc3,rad={rad}',
                               shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0),

import asyncio, threading
from http.server import HTTPServer, SimpleHTTPRequestHandler
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

async def main():
    server = HTTPServer(('127.0.0.1', 8766), SimpleHTTPRequestHandler)
    t = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    t.start()

    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(
            headless=True,
            args=['--no-sandbox', '--disable-setuid-sandbox', '--disable-gpu']
        )
        page = await browser.new_page(viewport={'width': 2200, 'height': 1400})

        page.on('console', lambda msg: print(f'[CONSOLE] {msg.type}: {msg.text[:200]}'))
        page.on('pageerror', lambda err: print(f'[PAGE ERROR] {err}'))

        await page.goto('http://127.0.0.1:8766/diagram.html', wait_until='networkidle')

        try:
            await page.wait_for_selector('#diagram svg', timeout=120000)
            print('SVG rendered successfully')
        except Exception as e:
            print(f'Timeout waiting for SVG: {e}')
            content = await page.text_content('#diagram')
            print(f'Diagram content: {content[:500] if content else "empty"}')

        await page.wait_for_timeout(4000)  # Ensure all rendering complete

        # Get actual content dimensions
        svg_el = await page.query_selector('#diagram svg')
        if svg_el:
            box = await svg_el.bounding_box()
            if box:
                print(f'SVG bounding box: {box["width"]:.0f}x{box["height"]:.0f}')

        body = await page.query_selector('body')
        if body:
            box = await body.bounding_box()
            if box:
                w = max(2400, int(box['width']) + 100)
                h = max(1600, int(box['height']) + 100)
                print(f'Body box: {box["width"]:.0f}x{box["height"]:.0f}, viewport: {w}x{h}')
                await page.set_viewport_size({'width': w, 'height': h})

        await page.screenshot(path='/app/output/result.png', full_page=True)
        print('Screenshot saved')

        await browser.close()
    server.shutdown()

asyncio.run(main())
